# Pada Design System

> Pada (`pada-ds`) is a React design system written in TypeScript: components, CSS design tokens, and light/dark theming. It needs `react` and `react-dom` 19 as peer dependencies.

## Install

```bash
npm install pada-ds
```

## Usage

Import the tokens and the component styles once at the app root, then import components by name from the package root:

```tsx
import 'pada-ds/tokens.css';
import 'pada-ds/styles.css';
import { Button } from 'pada-ds';

<Button variant="primary">Save</Button>
```

- `pada-ds/tokens.css`: design tokens (CSS custom properties, all prefixed `--pada-`) only.
- `pada-ds/tokens`: token names as `var()` strings and breakpoints for JS (`import { tokens, breakpoints } from 'pada-ds/tokens'`); `pada-ds/tokens.scss` and `pada-ds/tokens.json` carry the same tokens for Sass and design tools.
- `pada-ds/styles.css`: styles for every component.
- `pada-ds/headless`: unstyled, accessible parts with no CSS (`Dialog`, `Popover`, `Tooltip`, `DropdownMenu`, plus `Slot`, `Portal`, `VisuallyHidden` and hooks). Compose them as `<Dialog.Root><Dialog.Trigger/><Dialog.Portal><Dialog.Overlay/><Dialog.Content><Dialog.Title/></Dialog.Content></Dialog.Portal></Dialog.Root>`; style them through `data-state`, `data-side` and `aria-*` attributes; `asChild` merges a part onto your own element.
- `pada-ds/base.css` (optional): document base styles (`body` background, color and font; zero `p` margins).
- `pada-ds/manifest.json`: machine-readable component API (props, types, defaults, descriptions).

## Theming

By default the theme follows the operating system (`prefers-color-scheme`). Set `data-theme="light"` or `data-theme="dark"` on `<html>` or on any container to force a theme for that subtree. Remove the attribute to follow the OS again.

More theme axes work the same way and combine freely: `data-accent` (a palette hue such as `indigo`, `amber`, `emerald`, or `custom` with `--pada-accent-hue`), `data-neutral` (`stone`, `slate`, `gray`, `zinc`, `neutral`), `data-density` (`compact`, `comfortable`, `spacious`), `data-radius` (`none`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`), `data-motion` (`reduced`, `full`) and `data-contrast` (`standard`, `more`).

Style custom UI with semantic tokens rather than raw colours: `--pada-color-surface`, `--pada-color-fg`, `--pada-color-fg-muted`, `--pada-color-border`, and per intent (`accent`, `neutral`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info`) `--pada-color-<intent>-solid`, `-solid-hover`, `-on-solid`, `-subtle`, `-fg`, `-border`. Spacing is `--pada-space-<n>` (n × 0.25rem × density), radius `--pada-radius-xs` to `-3xl`, motion `--pada-duration-fast|normal|slow` with `--pada-ease-standard|enter|exit|emphasized`, layers `--pada-z-dropdown|modal|popover|toast|tooltip`.

## Components

Every component is a named export: `import { Name } from 'pada-ds'`. Props marked `?` are optional. Full prop tables with types, defaults and examples are in llms-full.txt.

- Accordion: header, headerIconName?, children, defaultOpen?, open?, onOpenChange?, className?, disabled?, headingLevel?
- Accordion.Content: forceMount?; extends ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>
- Accordion.Item: value, disabled?; extends ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>
- Accordion.Root: type, value?, defaultValue?, onValueChange?, collapsible?, disabled?, orientation?, dir?; extends Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>, 'defaultValue' | 'dir'>
- Accordion.Trigger: iconName?, headingLevel?, asChild?; extends ComponentPropsWithRef<'button'>
- AccordionContent: children; extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
- AccordionHeader: title, iconName?, collapsed?; extends Omit<React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, 'title'>
- Alert: tone?, title?, icon?, actions?, onDismiss?, live?; extends Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>, 'title'>
- AlertDialog.Action: children?, variant?, size?, leftIcon?, rightIcon?, split?, onSplitClick?, disabled?, loading?, ref?; extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>
- AlertDialog.Cancel: children?, variant?, size?, leftIcon?, rightIcon?, split?, onSplitClick?, disabled?, loading?, ref?; extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>
- AlertDialog.Content: onOpenAutoFocus?, size?, container?, overlayProps?, forceMount?, onCloseAutoFocus?, onEscapeKeyDown?; extends Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>, 'onPointerDownOutside' | 'onInteractOutside'>
- AlertDialog.Description: asChild?; extends ComponentPropsWithRef<'p'>
